boot_cmdline.description: Kernel command line for boot; empty string = boot with no cmdline

check_mtd.description: Check for bad blocks on specified MTD device; empty = all devices

cold_flash.description: Cold flash secondary images (for dead device with erased bootloader)

device_id.description: Enable device identification (show all device info)

disable_checks.description: Disable hash, checksum, and image type checking

dump_to_dir.description: Directory to dump all device images to

dump_to_fiasco.description: Path to dump all device images into one FIASCO image file

fiasco_image.description: Path to existing FIASCO image to use (e.g., for flashing or unpacking)

generate_fiasco.description: Path to generate new FIASCO image file; if ends with %sw, use SW release version

identify_images.description: Identify and list FIASCO image contents

image_filter_type.description: Filter images by image type (e.g., kernel, initfs)

input_images.description: List of input images to specify for flashing/generation; each is a dict with fields dev/hw/ver/type/file/lay (all optional except type and file). See man -m arg section for format [[[dev:[hw:]]ver:]type:]file[%lay].

load_to_ram.description: Load kernel & initfs images to RAM and boot

rd_flags.description: List of R&D flags to enable/disable (see man page for valid values)

simulate.description: Simulate operations without flashing or writing

unpack_fiasco.description: Directory to unpack FIASCO image to

usb_host_mode.description: Enable USB host mode (disable if false)
